mapIdentity.scope: All 16 building envelopes and the two residential courtyard voids come from the native museum site relation and individual footprint records. The regional museum is reconstructed as a single dated compound with distinct ceremonial, residential and museum buildings.

note: The Fine Arts Department records the twelve-bay Siwamokkhaphiman Hall with stepped roof slopes and ties the separate audience hall to the three connected Phra Wiman residential buildings. The Princess Maha Chakri Sirindhorn Anthropology Centre records Buddhaisawan’s raised masonry, its end terraces and two stepped roof slopes. Front Palace portal dimensions, roof heights and floors are estimated from cleared originals and surrounding terrain.
